body.text: As rail staff at Eurostar suspend [two strikes this month for talks](http://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-37031386) in a dispute over their work-life balance, and [discussions between unions and management at Southern ](http://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-37034764)continue, we look at recent and historic statistics on industrial action in the UK.

body.text: This is mainly because disputes in this group tend to be large. Education has also seen a large strike rate.
